verdict.rationale: WorkOS Directory Sync supports SCIM and dozens of directory integrations. It sends automatic updates for changes to directories, groups and users, delivered via webhooks or the Events API, and lets IT contacts activate and deactivate accounts. Community users independently praise its SCIM wrapper and setup wizard. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that an IdP deprovisioning event automatically revokes active app sessions or access (the evidence implies the app must act on the deactivation events itself).
